usageNotes: Permanently deletes a named IPSet from a VM's firewall configuration. By default the request fails if the IPSet still contains members; pass force=true to delete all member CIDRs/IPs atomically with the set. Requires VM.Config.Network permission on the target VM.

examples.summary: Delete an empty IPSet from a VM firewall
Force-delete an IPSet that still has members

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named IPSet and, when force=true, all its member IP/CIDR entries; any firewall rules referencing this IPSet by name will break silently.
tips: Check for firewall rules that reference the IPSet by name before deleting — Proxmox does not cascade-update rules that cite a deleted IPSet.
Omitting force when the IPSet has members returns a 500 error; use force=true to delete non-empty sets in a single call.
The operation returns null on success (not a UPID); it is synchronous.
